analysis.title: Flowserve Corp. (FLS): First Take: 3Q beat, FY26 guide raised, record aftermarket orders
key_insights: FLS reported 3Q26 adj. EPS of $1.07 against GS $0.97 and FactSet $0.98 consensus estimates. The year-ago figure was $0.90. GS calls it a better-than-expected result and expects the shares to outperform the next day.

Segment EBIT beat by 8% vs. GS and 5% vs. FactSet consensus. Segment operating margin was 20.0%, against GS 18.5% and FactSet 19.1%. Pump Division (FPD) drove the beat with EBIT of $181mn vs. GS $161mn and FactSet $169mn, a 21.8% margin vs. 19.8% GS and 20.4% FactSet.

Total revenue was $1,238mn (+5.4% y/y), in line with GS $1,233mn and FactSet $1,239mn. The beat came from margin, not sales. Flow Control Division revenue of $412mn was 2% below GS and 1% below FactSet, with a margin of 16.3% roughly in line.
Organic growth was -1.2% in 3Q26 (the report prints '+-1.2%'), against a GS estimate of +0.3%.
Bookings were $1.38bn, +8% organic y/y, with a book-to-bill of 1.12x, up from $1.35bn in 2Q. Aftermarket (AM) bookings were a record $728mn, +11% y/y.
FLS raised the low end of its FY26 adj. EPS guide to $4.10 to $4.20 from $4.05 to $4.20. GS and FactSet were at $4.10. The raise reflects the 3Q beat and stronger margins.
FLS cut its FY26 organic revenue growth outlook to -2.5% to -1.5% from about -1%, citing turmoil in the Middle East. Higher margins offset the lower sales outlook in the EPS guide.
GS stays Neutral with a 12-month price target of $81, based on 12.0x its Q5-Q8 EBITDA. The stock closed at $71.81 on 28 Oct 2026, 12.8% below the target. The target is unchanged from 30 Sep 2026.

GS estimates FLS EPS of $4.10 for 2026, $4.55 for 2027 and $5.00 for 2028, with 2026 EBITDA of $873.5mn on revenue of $4,868mn. At 17.5x 2026E P/E and 11.8x EV/EBITDA, the stock trades at a premium to 2025 multiples (15.3x and 10.2x).
GS lists upside risks as improved execution, stronger-than-expected orders and industry consolidation. Downside risks are lower oil prices hurting demand and M&A integration issues.

market_movers.rationale: GS keeps Neutral and its $81 target after a 3Q26 EPS beat and a raised low end of the FY26 EPS guide. It expects the shares to outperform the next day, with a price target 12.8% above the $71.81 close.

earnings_insights: FLS 3Q26 adj. EPS $1.07 REPORTED on 10/28 vs. GS estimate $0.97 and FactSet consensus estimate $0.98 (3Q25: $0.90). Recurring net income $137mn vs. GS est $124mn and FactSet est $126mn on 128mn diluted shares.
FLS 3Q26 total segment operating income $248mn reported vs. GS est $229mn and FactSet est $237mn (+8%/+5% beat). Segment margin 20.0% reported vs. GS est 18.5% and FactSet est 19.1%.

FLS 3Q26 revenue $1,238mn reported (+5.4% y/y) vs. GS est $1,233mn and FactSet est $1,239mn. Pump Division revenue $830mn reported vs. GS est $816mn and FactSet est $828mn. Flow Control revenue $412mn reported vs. GS est $420mn and FactSet est $415mn.

FLS FY26 adj. EPS company guidance narrowed to $4.10 to $4.20 from $4.05 to $4.20, vs. GS est $4.10 and FactSet est $4.10. FY26 organic revenue growth guidance lowered to -2.5% to -1.5% from about -1%.
FLS 3Q26 bookings $1.38bn reported (+8% organic y/y, book-to-bill 1.12x) vs. $1.35bn in 2Q26. Record aftermarket bookings $728mn reported (+11% y/y).
GS quarterly EPS estimates: $0.95 for 6/26 (reported), $0.97 for 9/26E (the quarter just reported at $1.07), $1.33 for 12/26E and $0.98 for 3/27E.
risk_factors: Lower oil prices could reduce demand for Flowserve products.
Middle East turmoil is already weighing on FY26 organic revenue growth expectations.
